integrity: The stated analytic derivation is accompanied by an independently reconstructed finite-word enumeration; no external independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The channel allows exactly one duplication of length two; it does not resolve multiple or variable-length operations.
The receiver is uniformly chosen from all words of a given length; this is not the law induced by sampling a uniform source.
The binary distribution and the sharp worst inverse degree and mean have predecessors; novelty is confined to the full q-ary rational distribution and its fluctuation law.
Equivalent q-ary statements in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Exact finite-alphabet inverse-list spectrum for a two-symbol palindromic duplication
